Common mistakes
  • Shooting a forked mule deer buck on 2 November because "deer season runs to 10 December". From 1 November it is 4 points or nothing.
  • Running the quad up a 3-28 road in October "just to haul the deer out". Hauling game is hunting use.
  • Shooting on the South Thompson flats east of town, inside the Map C7 band.
